metadata.note: Houston METRORail (Red, Green, Purple lines), as of the GTFS feed pulled from METRO's resourcespace.com feed distribution point. Route geometry, frequency (headway_min, from real scheduled trip counts on a representative Wednesday, Aug 26 2026), and avg_speed_kmh (from real scheduled trip duration) are all sourced directly from the agency's own GTFS feed, same methodology as data/la_metro_rail.geojson and data/san_diego_trolley.geojson. Historical segments (pre-2026) were added from METRO's own line-opening history: the Jan 1 2004 opening of the Red Line (Houston's first modern light rail, along Main Street), its Dec 21 2013 North extension to Northline Transit Center, and the simultaneous May 23 2015 openings of the Green and Purple Lines to the East End and Third Ward/Southeast respectively. Unlike the GTFS-sourced 2026 segment, these older headway numbers are not derived from real historical timetables and should be read as illustrative estimates, not precise data.
metadata.line_label_audit: 2026-08-24: line labels normalised repo-wide to "<operating company>: <line name>" -- the company's common display name (legal suffixes dropped), then the line as a passenger would have known it, or its two terminals where the line carried no advertised name. Long intermediate station lists were reduced to endpoints. For features spanning several operators the company shown is the one that ran the line for most of its drawn years. See CLAUDE.md Rule 6.
